title: [P0] LAYOUT-GEOMETRY-001 — TextView measure is not const: the measure pass overwrites the stored maxLines cap, so setText() after a first measure paints a truncated block
author: Sh-TB
body_head:
## Summary

`TextView` measurement is **not const** with respect to text configuration. `ViewNode::num_lines` — the stored `android:maxLines` / `android:lines` / `singleLine` cap — is **overwritten by the measure pass with the observed line count**. Once a TextView is measured against a short string, that observed count becomes the permanent cap, and every later `setText()` of a longer string pain

title: [P0] LAYOUT-GEOMETRY-001 — View.setAlpha is stored and reported by getAlpha, but the draw walk never reads it: setAlpha(0.5f) paints pure opaque colour
author: Sh-TB
body_head:
## Summary

`View.setAlpha(float)` has **no effect on the framebuffer**. The runtime stores the value and `getAlpha()` faithfully returns it, so nothing looks broken from Java — but the draw walk never reads the field. A view calling `setAlpha(0.5f)` paints exactly as if it had never been called.

This is a **rendering** defect, not a layout defect: the view's bounds are correct, only the painted

title: [P0] LAYOUT-GEOMETRY-001 — android:textStyle and TextView.setTypeface are both discarded: bold and italic text render as normal
author: Sh-TB
body_head:
## Summary

Text style is discarded on **both** construction paths. `android:textStyle="bold"` and `setTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD)` are equally no-ops, so bold and italic text renders exactly like normal text.

This is three defects stacked on one law: **the style of a text run must reach the glyphs.**

I found this systematically rather than by luck. After fixing #702 (`setAlpha` stored-but-n

title: [P0] LAYOUT-GEOMETRY-001 — View.setRotation() never reaches the framebuffer: rotated views paint as unrotated rects
author: Sh-TB
body_head:
## Summary

`View.setRotation()` never reaches the framebuffer. The value is stored, `getRotation()` returns it, `getMatrix()` builds a correct matrix from it — and the draw walk never reads the field. A view rotated 0°, 45° or 90° paints as the same upright rectangle.

The draw walk's own comment admitted the gap:

> `rotation-about-pivot stays the rotation frontier`

title: [P0] A DEX boolean argument is silently dropped by 574 INT32-only bridge tests — setAllCaps and setTypeface are dead as a result
author: Sh-TB
body_head:
## Summary

`DalvikValue`'s payload is a **union**. A DEX `boolean` parameter arrives as `DalvikType::BOOLEAN` (value 9) with its payload in the `bool_val` member. Bridge handlers test the type inline:

```cpp
if (args[1].type == DalvikType::INT32)   // rejects BOOLEAN outright
```
